edits.value: Backend engineer with 5 years building Python and FastAPI services on AWS. Cut checkout p95 latency 40% at Acme Corp for 2M monthly orders and reduced on-call pages from 6 to 1 per week with Datadog dashboards. Ships infrastructure for a 12-service distributed system on AWS ECS with Terraform and Docker.
Rebuilt the checkout API on FastAPI with PostgreSQL connection pooling and per-endpoint Datadog dashboards, cutting p95 latency 40% for 2M monthly orders and on-call pages from 6 to 1 per week
Wrote reusable Terraform modules for ECS task definitions across the 12-service distributed system on AWS, with Docker images built in GitHub Actions, so a new service ships in one pull request
